newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Savings Bank well-traded on quieter Estonia mkt.
newsitem.headline: Savings Bank well-traded on quieter Estonia mkt.

text.p: Shares on the Estonian bourse saw quieter trade on Wednesday but second bank Savings Bank stood out with high volumes.
The official list trade came to 32.9 million kroons and the Tallinn stock exchange index rose by 0.60 percent to 130.64.
Savings Bank saw high turnover of 21 million kroons but its stock rose only a little to 60.17 kroons from 60 kroons.
Leading bank Hansapank, which earlier released its 11-month results, turned over just 3.8 million kroons and was higher at 132.35 kroons after 131.25 kroons yesterday.
Tallinn Pharmaceuticals was also well traded after it released its 10-month results. It turned over 4.8 million kroons and rose to 72 kroons from 70.25.
The over-the-counter free market turned over 6.6 million kroons and the Norma plastics company was the most traded on 3.5 million litas and was stable to 21.70 litas.
